snippet.title: Feed the Scorchpot — Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
You run a medieval farm with one tenant who matters: a dragon who's your landlord, your critic, and your nemesis. Manage the farm, cook the meals, and keep the dragon fed for twenty years without going bankrupt. Every roll matters. Every dish is one bad decision from disaster.

———
